newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tibet Mining plans to issue 45 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Tibet Mining plans to issue 45 mln A shares.

text.p: Tibet Mining Industry Co Ltd plans an initial public offering of 45 million A shares this year which will be listed on the Shenzhen bourse, a company official said on Monday.

The company, based in Lhasa, capital of Tibet Autonomous Region, expects to go public by June 1997 after receiving the go-ahead from China Securities Regulatory Commission, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm is likely to choose China Everbright Securities Co Ltd as the lead underwriter, the official said.
Tibet Mining plans to use the stock proceeds to expand facilities to raise its annual chromium iron mining capacity to 100,000 tonnes from the current 40,000, the official said.
After the offer, the company would have 100 million outstanding shares, composed of 55 million state shares and 45 million A shares, he said.
